title: Gluing compatible families over generated simplex faces
statement: Let V be a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] in any category C, and T an object of C. Let e_i:[d_i] to [N] be any family of simplices, and let t_i:T to V_{d_i}. Suppose t_i V(q)=t_j V(r) whenever q e_i=r e_j. On the union of the subcomplexes generated by e_i there is a family T to V_m, natural in all simplex operators, with value t_i at each generator e_i.

source.place: Tag 017J, compatible simplicial families; elementary descent from a union of simplicial subsets

proof.text: Membership in the union of generated subcomplexes says exactly that a simplex factors through one generator. This follows from the pointwise supremum and the membership criterion for a subcomplex generated by a simplex.

Choose one generator factorization for each simplex and assign t_i followed by V of its factor map. The pairwise compatibility hypothesis shows independence from the chosen factorization. A simplex operator precomposes that factorization, proving naturality. The identity factorization gives the stated generator value.

theorem glue_face_family {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (V : SimplicialObject C) (T : C) {ι : Type*} {N : ℕ} (d : ι → ℕ)
    (e : ∀ i, ⦋d i⦌ ⟶ ⦋N⦌) (t : ∀ i, T ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋d i⦌))
    (ht : ∀ (i j : ι) (m : ℕ) (q : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋d i⦌) (r : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋d j⦌),
      q ≫ e i = r ≫ e j → t i ≫ V.map q.op = t j ≫ V.map r.op) :
    ∃ f : ∀ m : ℕ, (faceUnion.{w} d e).toSSet.obj (op ⦋m⦌) →
        (T ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋m⦌)),
      (∀ (m k : ℕ) (φ : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋k⦌)
        (s : (faceUnion.{w} d e).toSSet.obj (op ⦋k⦌)),
        f k s ≫ V.map φ.op = f m ((faceUnion d e).toSSet.map φ.op s)) ∧
      ∀ i, f (d i) ⟨SSet.stdSimplex.objEquiv.symm (e i),
        faceUnion_generator_mem d e i⟩ = t i
